nodes.text: Comatose patient with catastrophic brain injury: establish prerequisite conditions
Prerequisites: normothermia, systolic blood pressure >= 100 mm Hg, rule out CNS depressants
Document coma with complete absence of motor response to painful central stimulation
Demonstrate absence of all brainstem reflexes: pupillary, corneal, oculocephalic, oculovestibular, cough/gag
**Any brainstem reflex present (such as caloric response):** brain death cannot be declared
Perform apnea test: absence of spontaneous respiratory effort with elevated PaCO2
Obtain ancillary testing (cerebral angiography or EEG) if apnea testing cannot be completed
